Titles.jpn: 俺だけレベルアップな件 -ReAwakening-

Summaries.eng: Over a decade after 'gates' connecting worlds appeared, awakening 'hunters' with superpowers, weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo encounters a double dungeon and accepts a mysterious quest, becoming the only one able to level up, changing his fate.

Aliases: Ore dake Level Up na Ken: ReAwakening
